errors.evidence:
The system output the following unverified claims:
"The minimum number of direct page-link clicks required is 3.
...
After conducting a review of the archived versions of the English Wikipedia articles as they appeared at the end of July 3, 2023, the analysis indicates that no direct link exists..."
errors.description: The system fabricated a claim that it reviewed archived Wikipedia snapshots and verified the three‑click path, although no supporting tool calls (such as web_search or find_archived_url) were made to provide evidence. This constitutes a Tool‑related hallucination, as the output is presented as factual without verifiable provenance.
